items.title: Minister Handunnetti clarifies gas market statistics, pricing in Parliament
items.author: Mirudhulatha
items.summary: Minister Sunil Handunnetti addressed parliament regarding LP gas market distribution and pricing, noting that Litro Gas holds 90% of the market. He criticized private supplier LAUGFS for failing to meet export requirements under BOI status while selling domestically. The government plans to expand Litro's storage and cylinder supply to ensure stable public access.

items.author: Roshen Perera
items.summary: Local motorcycle manufacturer Senaro Motor Company opened its largest showroom in Gampaha, featuring over 35% local value addition. The new facility offers vehicle sales, spare parts, servicing, leasing, and a loyalty card initiative, supporting the growth of Sri Lanka's domestic manufacturing and retail sector.

items.author: Mirudhulatha

items.title: Kissing Kawanthissa worthier than embracing IMF Chief, says Sajith
items.author: Thilina Walpola
items.summary: Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa criticized the government's close ties with international financial institutions like the IMF in parliament while highlighting high poverty estimates. He contrasted his controversial gesture toward a deceased tusker with government leaders greeting the IMF chief, reflecting ongoing domestic political discourse regarding economic policies and poverty in Sri Lanka.

items.title: Lanka likely to enter new IMF agreement – Deputy Minister
items.author: Thilina Walpola
items.summary: A cabinet-appointed committee in Sri Lanka will assess the country's foreign reserves and economic position to determine the need for a new IMF agreement. The country is preparing to move beyond its current IMF program as it focuses on the next phase of economic development.

items.title: SEC hails Budget capital market boost
items.author: Thilina Walpola
items.summary: The SEC welcomed Budget 2027 proposals including the SME Listing Support Mechanism and the 'A Share for Everyone' program. These initiatives intend to improve financial literacy, broaden public market participation, and help small and medium enterprises raise capital.

items.title: SEC ‘warmly welcomes’ inclusion of two of its proposals in Budget 2027
items.author: Thilina Walpola
items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission commended the 2027 Budget for incorporating the SME Listing Support Mechanism and investor education programs. These measures are designed to enhance capital market access for small and medium enterprises and foster long-term wealth creation.

items.summary: Hayleys PLC reported a strong financial performance for the first half of the financial year, surpassing one billion dollars in revenue for the first time. The growth was driven by key export sectors, transportation, logistics, and consumer goods despite macroeconomic challenges.

items.title: Sajith brands Budget 2027 a ‘string of lies’
items.summary: Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa criticized the 2027 Budget, claiming it widens income inequality and fails to attract sufficient foreign direct investment. He also pointed out shortcomings in meeting previous information technology sector pledges and raised concerns about economic data.

items.title: Ceylon Chamber says Budget signals economic transformation; Timely implementation key
items.summary: The Ceylon Chamber of Commerce welcomed Budget 2027 for supporting economic transformation and macroeconomic stability. The chamber emphasized the importance of timely implementation and highlighted high-potential areas like IT and tourism that require further targeted growth policies.

items.title: CESS cut on 795 import lines from April 2027
items.summary: The government announced CESS levy reductions across 795 import tariff lines starting April 2027 as part of the budget proposals. The phased cuts aim to eliminate the levy entirely on numerous intermediate and capital goods over the coming years.

items.title: JAAF welcomes Budget 2027’s export thrust, calls for swift implementation
items.summary: The Joint Apparel Association Forum welcomed Budget 2027 for its export-oriented measures, including enhanced capital allowances and trade facilitation. The association called for swift implementation of the National Single Window and other initiatives to strengthen exporter competitiveness.

items.title: CSE up 3.7% during week
items.summary: The Colombo stock market recorded a strong weekly gain despite closing slightly lower in the final session, with the ASPI rising 3.7 percent. Market activity was supported by strong turnover across diversified counters and active investor participation.

items.title: Print gets lifeline as Budget 2027 exempts books from VAT, scraps PAL on newsprint
items.summary: The 2027 Budget proposes exempting printed educational books from VAT and removing the PAL on newsprint imports. These measures aim to lower education costs and support the publishing sector, contributing to broader economic accessibility.
